# The Franklin Craftsman

> Fine wallpaper installation, custom wainscoting and paneling, and premium bathroom remodels in Spring Hill and Williamson County, Tennessee (Spring Hill, Thompson's Station, Franklin, Brentwood, Nolensville, Leiper's Fork) and greater Nashville. Based in Spring Hill, TN. Owner-operated by Sean Penner (SRP Renovations LLC) — the same craftsman answers the phone and does the work. One project at a time, one-year workmanship warranty.

## Specialty: Wallpaper Installation

The Franklin Craftsman is one of the few skilled paperhangers serving Spring Hill, Thompson's Station, Franklin, and Williamson County, TN. Unlike most installers, wall preparation (skim coating, drywall repair, old wallpaper removal) is part of the service — done by a finish carpenter and remodeler by trade. Peel-and-stick wallpaper is not offered.

Papers installed: grasscloth and natural fibers, mural and panel papers (optionally framed in custom molding), hand-printed and block-printed papers, and wide-width and commercial vinyls. Interior designers welcome: works from designer specs, inspects client-purchased paper, flags quantity and dye-lot issues before install day.

## Specialty: Wainscoting & Paneling

Custom wainscoting and wall paneling built and painted by a finish carpenter: board and batten, raised panel, shaker flat panel, picture-frame (applied) molding, full-height paneling, shiplap, chair rail, and crown. Layout is planned to the room's proportions before the first cut. Every job is caulked, filled, primed, and painted — a finished wall, not a carpentry kit. Existing trim profiles matched where possible.

- [Wainscoting & Paneling — Williamson County TN](https://franklincraftsman.com/wainscoting.html): styles with diagrams, what's included, and FAQ including cost guidance
- [Home](https://franklincraftsman.com/): full services — fine wallpaper, wainscoting & trim, bathroom remodels
